max_common_note: A shared @max-common fit assignment is a scoring-input effort-class label. It does not document matched vendor reference configuration, equal compute, or the same thinking/effort control.

draft_lock.mismatch_with_implemented_candidate: Lock roster is directed-forest Student-t walk siblings. Implemented candidate is an exchangeable restricted class prior with one global rho. This review uses lock evaluation safeguards and does not treat A/B as selected or implemented.

operating_floor.applies_to: fully_compatible_reviewed_classes, not the pre-config upper bound

gemini_exclusion.role: confirmation exclusion only; not a certified lineage

counts.counting_rule: original documented multi-member components, not domain blocks or subclasses; availability requires successor lambda>=0.25 in domain k and classmate lambda>=0.25 in that domain; fully compatible additionally requires certified reference-configuration compatibility

schema_note: TransferClass class objects allow only class_id, member_models, derivation_evidence, reference_configuration_compatibility, is_singleton, notes. Original-component provenance is in registry metadata.components, not extra class keys.
